surface.output: One two-paragraph body. The first two complete sentences become the collapsed-card preview.
surface.person: we, someone, a named group, or the actual subject; never generic people or second person
hardRules: Begin with recognizable behavior, a decision, or a consequence.
Make the first two sentences complete, strong, and immediately clear because the card truncates after them.
Build one advancing lived sequence rather than an inventory of examples.
Mention the exact event naturally by the third sentence at the latest.
Use normal English. Do not make an abstract noun perform a human action.
Do not use em dashes, cryptic slogans, advocacy-default subject matter, corporate language, or a second conclusion.
End with the clearest behavioral truth, then stop.

ownerPassages.text: Friendships may shift now. The ability to change friendship groups is a luxury. Not everyone gets to walk away from community, even when it stops feeling aligned.
The ability to change friendship groups is a luxury. Not everyone gets to walk away from community, even when it stops feeling aligned.

Collectively, we begin to learn the cost of comfort, the limits of growth, and that real care needs a structure, a schedule and not just sentiment. There may not be a resolution this month, but there will be motion.

Jupiter in Cancer reminds us that expansion doesn’t always look like growth on the outside. Sometimes, it’s the deep roots we plant within ourselves and our communities that create the most lasting change.

Without Leo, Aquarius risks becoming a detached intellect, a thinker without a heartbeat. Aquarius gives Leo perspective. It reminds the Sun-ruled that their light is not just for themselves, it can be a beacon, a force for change. It pulls Leo out of self-obsession and into the realm of innovation, reminding them that true power isn’t about dominance, it’s about influence.

Twitter launched that spring. Facebook was expanding beyond Harvard. Leo, the sign associated with self-expression and visibility, was activated during a time when the internet was beginning to reshape how we presented ourselves to the world.
